summary: Rewrote the makefiles (generated headers under build/gen, dependency tracking, flag-change stamp for DEBUG=1, correct link order and -static, check/install fixes including both man pages and PREFIX-correct qs.pc), deleted the stale hand-copied include/qs/ops.h, and fixed all -Wall -Wextra warnings in the sources without changing behavior (also neg operand now uses prec+1 and parse_size rejects overflow).
